title: Honeycomb Marker
description: JSON Schema for the Honeycomb Marker resource. Generated from the Honeycomb API OpenAPI spec.

start_time.description: Indicates the time the Marker should be placed. If missing, defaults to the time the request arrives. Expressed in Unix Time.

end_time.description: Specifies end time, and allows a Marker to be recorded as representing a time range, such as a 5 minute deploy. Expressed in Unix Time.

message.description: A message to describe this specific Marker.

type.description: Groups similar Markers. For example, `deploys`. All Markers of the same type appear with the same color on the graph. Refer to the [Marker Settings](/api/marker-settings/) API for altering the color of each type.

url.description: A target for the marker. Clicking the marker text will take you to this URL.

id.description: A 6 character hexadecimal string assigned on Marker creation.

created_at.description: The ISO8601-formatted time when the Marker was created.

updated_at.description: The ISO8601-formatted time when the Marker was updated.

color.description: Color can be assigned to Markers using the Marker Settings endpoint. This field will be populated when List All Markers is called.
